states.initialLoading: Page lines 97-100 derive loading only from sources without retained arrays. AlignmentStats, ChartContainer and AlignmentPairs receive loading; shell sections remain present for selected vehicles.
states.empty: Resolved empty arrays remain loaded data. Statistics guard undefined denominator/dwell with missing reasons, while paired count can correctly show zero. Chart and pairs explain no temporal pairs. No loaded history is presented as lifetime coverage.
states.fatalError: Each failed initial source has independent QueryError/refetch (143-146); chart receives first fatal error and retries whichever sources are fatal (199-203). Statistics and pairs retain shells with missing reason.
states.partial: Analysis statistics are withheld until both arrays have loaded; independent successful-source counts/bounds remain visible. This is the established two-source prerequisite, not a deleted section.
states.staleRefresh: Refresh failures/paused reads with retained arrays are nonfatal; summaries and pairs remain usable with per-source warnings and retained brief status (106-109, 142).
states.offlinePaused: Missing paused sources render DataStateNotice with localized explanation and source-specific retry (147-156). Browser offline detection itself was not tested.
states.unknown: Missing timestamps yield no observed bounds; null/non-finite SoC stays unknown. Existing missing metric display uses undefined/null, not model zero.
states.noVehicle: Page lines 93-95 use existing NoVehicleSelected onboarding CTA instead of issuing enabled history requests or rendering misleading analytics.

issues.detail: The page-specific caller does not override ChargingSummaryBrief description/status wording. That owner defaults to 'Recorded measurements from the stated charging source and scope' (ChargingSummaryBrief.tsx:45-46) and 'Source measurements available' (line 29), although dwell/flag rates/pair counts are derived from two histories. The secondary inference caveat (AlignmentStats.tsx:101-104) helps but is not the primary summary description.
issues.fix: Use the existing description/sourceStatus props to clearly identify retrospective derived alignment metrics and both input histories. Retain loading/retained/partial/unknown distinctions, caveats and the Review details narrative; do not globally relabel other charging briefs.

visualIssues.detail: Chart uses shared fixed blue/red/amber series, with heuristic bars at full opacity and a dotted amber line (248-250). tokens.ts:401 confirms saturated #3b82f6/#ef4444/#f59e0b entries. This is shared palette usage rather than hardcoded page neon; full-opacity red flags can dominate a dense analytical plot. Rendered intensity remains unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Review populated chart in supported themes, retaining semantic flag distinction and saved preferences. Prefer existing restrained chart treatments and non-color labels over glow/gradients or a new page palette. Shared palette changes require a designated owner, not this page worker.

visualIssues.detail: Chart tick font sizes are page-authored 10/11px literals rather than a reviewed shared chart typography role. Tokens are used for text colors; no fixed-white text is present in the scoped page/feature presentation files.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse the chart owner's established typography/preferences contract where supported, without modifying source model, data series or axis units. Verify legibility before claiming visual quality.

architectureIssues.detail: StatMetric type is imported directly from @/components/data-display/stat-reference while adjacent charging bridge uses the category barrel. This is a type-only internal dependency, not a proven runtime cycle.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing category-level public StatMetric type export if available; otherwise report the exact missing export to its shared owner rather than editing the barrel in a page item.

architectureIssues.detail: Local date-only chart labels omit year/time, while bounds and pair rows call native toLocaleString separately (page 176-177; AlignmentPairs.tsx:30). Same-month/day records across years can share chart labels. Pair caption explicitly discloses browser timezone; changing that behavior would be a migration, not cosmetic cleanup.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse existing date-format ownership where it preserves the established browser-timezone behavior, and retain complete timestamp context in chart alternatives/tooltips. Do not silently reinterpret timestamps or change date filtering.

dataBehavior: Selected vehicle only; disabled history hooks without a vehicle; separate cache keys and cancellation signals remain unchanged.
Bounded loaded history requests; no workspace date range and no complete lifetime claim.
First drive strictly after charge end and within default 24h; latest eligible charge wins when multiple sessions map to one drive. Ended invalid/missing sessions are not evaluated.

Dwell is rounded SI seconds in model; convert to rounded minutes only at chart/table/stat display boundary. Keep percent-point arithmetic and nullable SoC; do not introduce legacy distance/energy helpers.
Defaults remain 15% tight margin, 40-point excess buffer, 95% full SoC, 1h early-full dwell, 4h long dwell and 3-point positive SoC mismatch. Negative drift alone is not flagged.
Preserve avg margin's existing one-decimal model rounding and configured display precision/locale, and pair percentages' existing formatter behavior.
Model zero aggregates with no pairs remain guarded by metric missing reasons; known paired count zero is not unknown.
Retained arrays survive errors/offline pauses; loaded neighbor source count/bounds remain independent.
Chart rows remain oldest-first from sorted model pairs; detail table reverses a copy newest-first without mutating model/cache.
CSV currently excludes boolean misaligned. Any accessible textual flag addition must be additive and preserve all original columns/actions.
